title: i-Series Modular Area + Decorative Lights
headline: Modular Solar Lighting System
intro: Solera Solar Lighting sets a new standard in solar lighting performance. i-Series delivers a year-round, configurable solar-powered lighting system engineered to provide bright, reliable illumination wherever you need it.
callouts: Configure the intelligent modular system to fit your application
It's not just lighting — it's visibility. Control. Data.
Recommended mounting height: Modular Area + Decorative Lights 20 ft – 30 ft
